reviews.title: Staff Augmentation for Assistance Company
reviews.quote: Their commitment, efficiency, listening skills, and professionalism were impressive.
reviews.summary: Madiff provided competent developers at a reasonable cost. The team helped enhance legacy systems such as the web-based insurance selling portal and core assistance system. Deliverables were managed in tight two-week SCRUM sprints with flawless velocity.

reviews.title: AI System Development for IoT & UAV Solutions Company
reviews.quote: Madiff treated the project with real ownership, almost as if it were their own startup product.
reviews.summary: Madiff developed an end-to-end AI system integrating automated workflows, backend architecture, and machine learning models for drone/UAV platforms, significantly boosting operational automation and customer satisfaction.

reviews.title: BI & Big Data Consulting & SI for Data Analytics Company
reviews.quote: I was impressed that Madiff was ahead of schedule.
reviews.summary: Madiff provided high-tier BI and big data consulting to eliminate internal deployment blockers and streamline analytics throughput. Their intervention directly contributed to a 14% YoY revenue increase, with 10% directly attributed to Madiff's engineering pod.

reviews.title: Web Dev for International Consulting Firm
reviews.quote: We were impressed by the responsiveness of the project managers.
